lead_headline: AI SDK and Astro each ship two releases; Claude Code's agent surface accumulates a notable bug backlog
lead_body: Twenty-two commits landed in AI SDK today, delivering the Vue useChat composable, sandboxed file I/O wrappers, and a same-day Vertex project-ID backport alongside a Node 22 floor. Astro cut 6.3.4 and 6.3.5 within three hours, bundling a stale-content dev-server fix, CSP correction, and a full error-message overhaul. Claude Code shipped nothing substantive but drew a cluster of agent-mode reports worth reviewing before that surface sees wider use.
lead_article:
The busiest thread today runs through AI SDK, where twenty-two commits landed across CI hardening, dependency cleanup, and two substantive features. The Vue useChat composable shipped, extending the SDK's framework reach. The Experimental_Sandbox abstraction gained readFile and writeFile convenience wrappers — a quiet but meaningful step toward portable, sandboxed file I/O in agentic contexts. The Google Vertex project-ID propagation fix merged and was backported the same evening, and the minimum Node version moved to 22, trimming legacy surface area. Astro had an equally dense afternoon: 6.3.4 and 6.3.5 both shipped inside three hours, carrying the stale-content dev-server fix, CSP position-prop correction, a full error-message consistency overhaul, and TypeScript updated to v6. The advanced routing types and config-gaps feature also landed before the second release cut.

Workflow SDK closed out the night with versioning documentation committed twice — once direct, once backported — alongside a durable-agents guide updated to reference ToolLoopAgent, an immediate-retry fix for failed VQS handlers, and instrumentation stripped from workbench. Hydrogen merged three PRs: storefrontRedirect now handles Single Fetch client-side navigations correctly, the Image component descriptor fix for fluid images is in, and the skeleton recursive line-item children patch closed the day. Mantis added a diagnostic log for the absent source job cluster and removed a stale Netty 3.7 dependency. Gemma.cpp merged the removal of Q transposition in the tiled attention kernel. Claude Code generated no commits of consequence but accumulated a notable cluster of agent-mode bug reports — socket keepalives disabled via feature flag, subagent context budgets blown by eager MCP schema materialisation, and a background-fleet deleteJob silently unlinking session JSONL — each worth a look before the agents surface gets wider use.
